name: Opening Range Breakout on Stocks in Play (5-minute opening range), as recreated in QuantConnect Research
author_year: Zarattini, Barbon, Aziz (2024), SSRN 4729284 / Swiss Finance Institute RP 24-98; QuantConnect recreation by community author
instrument: [uncertain] US equities (top 20 'stocks in play' per day from a 1,000-stock universe). No FX, gold or crypto version in the library. Maven MT5 equivalent: none for stocks; the index-CFD analogue (US100) is untested.
timeframe: 5-minute opening range; signal check at 9:35 AM ET; exit at close
entry_rule: Universe: 1,000 most liquid US stocks above USD 5 with ATR > 0.50, daily top 20 by relative volume (first-5-minute volume divided by the 14-day average of the same bar). If the opening 5-minute bar closed above its open, place a buy stop at the opening-range high; if below its open, place a sell stop at the opening-range low.
exit_rule: Exit at stop-loss or at market close. If momentum continues, the position is closed at the close with a profit.
stop_rule: ATR(14)-based stop as a function of entry price; multiplier not stated in the post. Wider for more volatile assets. Position sized so a stop hit loses 1% of the allocated portfolio value.
holding_time: Intraday, from about 9:35 AM ET to the close
trades_per_year: [uncertain] Up to 20 positions per day, but the number of days entered and total trades per year are not reported.
overnight_weekend: No overnight or weekend holding per the post (exit at close)
signal_window_definition: Opening range = first 5-minute bar of the US cash session (9:30-9:35 AM ET); entry check at 9:35 AM ET. Source does not discuss DST handling; the platform uses exchange time [uncertain].
sample_period: 2016 only in the QuantConnect post (described as the first year of the paper's backtest). Original paper covers 2016-2023 across more than 7,000 US stocks.
out_of_sample: No out-of-sample or walk-forward test in the QuantConnect post; only in-sample parameter sweeps (17 of 25 combinations beat the benchmark Sharpe; ATR-threshold sweep Sharpe 1.5-2.7). Paper's out-of-sample status not verified (paper PDF not accessible).
cost_assumption: Not specified in the QuantConnect post. Original paper says results hold 'even after considering transaction costs' with no per-share or bps figure in the abstract.
reported_metrics: QuantConnect post (2016): strategy Sharpe 2.396, beta -0.042; SPY buy-and-hold Sharpe 0.836. Paper abstract (2016-2023, top-20 Stocks in Play): total net performance over 1,600%, Sharpe 2.81, annualized alpha 36%; S&P 500 passive total return 198%. CAGR, max drawdown and win rate not reported in the post (a commenter cites a 17% win rate, unverified).
third_party_replication: [uncertain] The QuantConnect post is itself a community recreation. Forum commenters question results for other years; no independent replication confirmed.
evidence_grade: kodlu backtest (QuantConnect community code) with working paper (SFI RP 24-98, SSRN 4729284; not peer-reviewed as of search)
decay_status: [uncertain] Commenters ask about 2016-2024 and say 'the backtest doesn't look good for other years'; no result for those years is shown. Paper claims period 2016-2023 as a whole.
regime_split: Not reported. Only 2016 in the post; paper's year-by-year results not verified.
data_source_requirement: US stock minute data with volume (for relative volume) and ATR. Not available on Maven MT5 or Dukascopy for individual stocks [uncertain for Dukascopy].
min_lot_fit_5k10k: [uncertain] Not computable for Maven. Stop is ATR-based and not given in the post. Risk formula: lot size x price x stop distance / account equity.
fn_rule_fit: [uncertain] Single-day momentum with one entry per stock; 5-minute bar trigger would not look like tick-scalping. Equity-specific data and news overlap (stocks in play are news-driven) not checked against FundedNext rules.
bot_policy_compliance: [uncertain] Programmatic and implementable via LEAN, but the instrument class is not available through Maven MT5 for the stated 5K/10K account.
event_overlap: Opening range covers the US cash open (9:30 ET). Stocks in play are often driven by earnings and company news, so overlap with scheduled corporate events is high by design. Macro release at 8:30 ET is pre-open and not directly inside the window.
overlap_with_existing: Low overlap with Sweep, NB and BTC 21-23 UTC modules (different instrument class and session). Partial conceptual overlap with Sweep (opening-range and intraday breakout), not quantified.
rejected_catalog_hit: [uncertain] Not checked. Main session must run python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol with 'opening range breakout', 'ORB' and 'stocks in play'. NQ ORB and Gold ORB are already retired in the project rules (per CLAUDE.md), so a family-level veto is likely [uncertain].
base_rate_check: [uncertain] Claimed Sharpe 2.4-2.8 is far above typical single-stock intraday strategies; base rate for ORB-style systems on liquid indices is much lower in the project's own NQ/Gold ORB results (NQ ORB forward exp_R -0.092 per project memory). Comparison not computed here.
pitfall_risk: Parameter sweep in-sample only; single-year example in QuantConnect post; 'stocks in play' selection is ex-post in part (relative volume uses current-day data); cost and slippage unspecified; 1% risk sizing on a stock universe does not transfer to a single CFD; family-level evidence from the project's own ORB modules is negative.
notes: Why this item: the only QuantConnect entry with a worked backtest code path, a stated trading rule, and a published academic counterpart. Out-of-sample evidence is absent in the QuantConnect post, so the item is weak as evidence despite the high reported Sharpe.
